annotations.title: Remind the people who have not recorded yet.

description: Works out who is still out, emails a reminder to the ones with an address, and hands back a message naming them, ready for the group chat and ready for one person. A person gets at most one reminder a day and three in all, and never one after they have said stop.

also_email.description: false returns the message and the taps and sends nothing. Without it, the reminder is emailed.
